ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white surface with a macro-level ratio of approximately 75% white to 25% black/dark-grey pixels localized at the margins and central junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white regions occupy the bulk of both lobes; low-intensity dark pigmentation forms a contiguous band at the peduncle junction and follows the trailing edge; a distinct dark focal spot is located on the medial-left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern featuring irregular pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys (3-6 pixels) along the entire span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the central notch, sweeping laterally with a slight posterior recurve at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast dark pixel clusters near the central notch and along the trailing edge perimeters.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) oriented perpendicular to the leading edge on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical rake marks on the left lobe; irregular dark scarring at the primary peduncle-fluke interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical dark mottling pattern concentrated heavily around the median notch area.
